rag.text:
Test: TC-1064 — Feature area - Extplatform Security - Jira Editable property check
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-47 Feature area - Security
Labels: teamextplatform

Description:
TC dotyczący sprawdzenia osbługi aplikacji, gdy Jira issue ma property (jira.issue.editable=false). Currently only for Atlassian Cloud 

Steps:
1. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-1064 Feature area - Extplatform Security - Jira Editable property check
   Expected: Gantt module of boxName is displayed.
3 jira issues are visible:
* TC-1064 TO DO - with status [To Do]
* TC-1064 IN PROGRESS - with status [In Progress]
* TC-1064 DONE - with status [Done]
2. Navigate to Story points column of taskName and try to set story points to 5
   Data: taskName TC-1064 In Progress
   Expected: Column Story points is not editable. The contents of the column Story points is still set to 2.
3. Hover over to taskName -> click tree dots button -> Edit and try to change priority
   Data: taskName TC-1064 In Progress
   Expected: Cannot change priority of task. Priority is not editable
